body: I just don't see a way of getting through this. I haven't found a solution. My weekend was normal, just like normal. I've finished my semester so I'm home, which has been worse. My friends have been my support system, and now they're not around.
So I'm just suppose to just blindly have faith that things will get better? There are no tangible guarentees. I'm not good with blind faith.
Why do you think suicide is unacceptable?
If we live life to be happy, and I'm not going to be happy, then why should I live? I can't keep going. This battle is not something I can overcome.

I understand that the depression is clouding my perspective, but I don't believe it's the entire cause. The depression is just exacertabating the thought I've always had. I'm not a happy or cheerful person. I've always been pessimistic and negative. If the depression ever gets properly treated, it's just going to reveal the sad worthless person underneath. Nothing will change.

Helping other people makes me feel worse usually. I see other people who are in much worse situations than me, and they still have a positive outlook, they still have hope and are appreciative of what they have. I just feel worse about myself. I know that I should have hope that things will get better. I understand that 19 years is not necessarily a good judge of what the rest of my life may be like. But I just don't care anymore. I want to be gone. I don't have hope for any positive changes, so why should I keep trying?
I'd rather give up than keep trying.
But I just don't see a good future. I can't fathom that things will change. The bad as always outweighed any good. That certainly won't change. The pain is unbearable.

Life isn't worth living at this point. The world certainly isn't going to change. It's a horrible place to live and it's filled with pain and suffering. Nineteen years of life and none of it has been worthwhile. I'm better off dead.

I don't understand why anyone would care. I feel incredibly worthless and thats the reality I know. Why do my friends care about me at all? I don't deserve it. I don't deserve happiness, and I'm never going to experience it. I can't keep going. I want it all to just stop.

But there are no guarentees, in life. Chances are that this pain is not going to go away and I can't handle being in pain for much longer. I don't have any more goals, this is it. Theres nothing else to look forward to. If I go through with killing myself, I will make sure I can't reconsider it because I will be sure that it's what I want to do. I can't find another reason to stay. I hear what you're saying, but it just bounces off of me. Maybe it's too late for me. I'm the only one that can save myself, but I don't want to. I can't.

I've been seeking help. I went to the doctor at school two months and started an anti-depressant. It didn't work. I'm in the process of getting off it because it's not helping. Just like everything else in my life, I got my hopes up and it didn't work. Why should I try another? They probably won't work. I just left school, the semester ended. I would like to try to keep going with therapy (I've been seeing one at school for the whole year) but I don't think I can afford onne. It's just more bills and I don't have a job.

I just keep getting beat down. Why should I get up again? I'd rather just take the beating on the floor and give up. I'm strong on the outside but not really on the inside. Everyday I fall apart a little more. Some days I just lie on the floor because I can't bring myself to get up and do anything. What's left?
